title: docs(skills): spec-property-retirement's retiredAfter item names the stamp under a prerelease label — the newest published stable release (#23057)
body:
Fixes #23057
Clause-②: no

The `spec-property-retirement` playbook's `retiredFromLoadPath` / `retiredAfter` checklist item told the author of a new retirement to stamp "`packages/spec/package.json` 的当前版本标签" (the package's current version label). Under a Changesets prerelease label (`18.0.0-next.N`) that value fails tsc's `${number}.${number}.${number}` template type and the census's `triple()`. This PR brings that one sentence into line with the rule the spec half already landed: the `retiredAfter` TSDoc in `packages/spec/src/conversions/types.ts` (`719183f50`, PR #23130). It adds no rule of its own and names that TSDoc as the authority.

**Tier S** (`.claude/**`): this PR stays draft. It lands only by the owning seat on a contract-tier review of record. The authoring seat does not flip it to ready, queue it, or arm auto-merge.

## The change

One file, `.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md`. Lines 205 and 206 are rewritten in place. Line 204 and lines 207 to 337 are byte-identical.

Before (base `02bec6ca8`):

```text
- [ ] **`retiredFromLoadPath: true` 与 `retiredAfter: 'x.y.z'`** —— 后者必填(缺则 `tsc` 拒),新退役填
      `packages/spec/package.json` 的当前版本标签(`retired-after.census.test.ts` 逐值钉;artifact 门据它
      逐条开窗)。前者退役恒真,但管辖权只有 authoring 漏斗
```

After (`9b14911b4c`):

```text
- [ ] **`retiredFromLoadPath: true` 与 `retiredAfter: 'x.y.z'`** —— 后者必填(缺则 `tsc` 拒),新退役填
      落地时最新 stable 发布(标签为 `x.y.z-next.N` 时永不填它或 `x.y.z`;`retired-after.census.test.ts`
      逐值钉;artifact 门据它逐条开窗;TSDoc 为准)。前者退役恒真,但管辖权只有 authoring 漏斗
```

## Acceptance notes

**The landed TSDoc text and the new sentence, side by side.** The TSDoc is quoted verbatim from `packages/spec/src/conversions/types.ts` at `02bec6ca8`:

| Landed `retiredAfter` TSDoc (`719183f50`) | Playbook sentence after this PR |
|:---|:---|
| "It is a FACT when the entry is written, never a guess at the next release number: the newest stable release at the moment the retirement lands, read off the package's version label." | 新退役填落地时最新 stable 发布 (a new retirement stamps the newest stable release at the moment it lands) |
| "Under a prerelease label (`x.y.z-PRERELEASE`, Changesets pre mode), it is the newest published stable release, which sits below `x.y.z` — never the label (not a stable `x.y.z`) and never `x.y.z`, the first stable release that carries the entry retired (`17.7.0` under `18.0.0-next.N`, say)." | 标签为 `x.y.z-next.N` 时永不填它或 `x.y.z` (when the label is `x.y.z-next.N`, never that label and never `x.y.z`) |
| The whole TSDoc block | TSDoc 为准 (the TSDoc is the authority) |

- **What the sentence leaves to the TSDoc pointer, and why.** The stable-label arm ("Under a stable label (`x.y.z`), it is the label itself") gets no clause of its own. Under a stable label, the newest stable release at landing is the label, so the general rule already gives that value. The TSDoc's paragraph on already-published entries (the census-refresh re-stamp) is not restated either. The item is about new retirements, and the old sentence never carried that paragraph. The `TSDoc 为准` pointer covers both.
- **Line budget (`check-skill-line-ratchet`).** 337 lines before and after (ceiling 337, headroom 0). The widest table row is 324 bytes before and after (pin 326). The rewritten lines are 118 and 117 bytes; before, they were 119 and 73. The new text fits on the sentence's own two lines, using the slack on line 206, which carried the tail of the same sentence's parenthetical. No line of other content was joined, moved or re-wrapped to make room. The pointer is the unqualified `TSDoc 为准` rather than a longer form such as `以其 TSDoc 为准` because the longer form makes line 206 121 bytes.
- **Premise check on `origin/main` `02bec6ca8`.** `packages/spec/package.json` reads `17.7.0` (a stable label). `.changeset/pre.json` is `mode: pre`, `tag: next`, so the next Version Packages pass writes `18.0.0-next.N`, and the old sentence would then hand an author a value that tsc and the census refuse. `719183f50` is an ancestor of `origin/main` (`git merge-base --is-ancestor` exit 0).
- **Observation, not filed, no carrier:** the gate's info line says this file's `max-table-row-bytes` pin has 2 bytes of headroom (widest row 324, pin 326) and suggests lowering it. That is true on the base too and is unrelated to this diff. Lowering it means editing `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, which is outside this card's file surface.

I built both under the shared verify lock (`pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint --concurrency=2`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`) and re-ran the gate: exit 0, the row above.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

- **改了什么:** `spec-property-retirement` 技能里 `retiredAfter` 那一条清单项。原文让新退役填 `packages/spec/package.json` 的当前版本标签;现改为填「落地时最新的 stable 发布」,并写明预发布标签(`x.y.z-next.N`)下永不填标签本身或 `x.y.z`,以 `retiredAfter` 的 TSDoc 为准。只改两行,文件行数不变(337)。
- **为什么改:** 仓库已处于 Changesets 预发布模式(`.changeset/pre.json`,tag `next`),下一次 Version Packages 会把版本标签写成 `18.0.0-next.N`;照旧句填写,`tsc` 与 census 都会拒。规则本身已由 spec 侧(PR #23130)写进 TSDoc,本 PR 只让技能文本跟上,不另立规则。
- **风险与代价(含回滚):** 纯内部 agent 文档,不发布任何包,不触运行时。回滚即 revert 这一个 commit。
